glosses: deposit, security, guaranty (guarantee that debt will be paid; property relinquished to ensure this)
forfeit (something deposited as part of a game)

examples.text: Il a dû mettre sa montre en gage.
examples.en: He had to pawn his watch.

examples.text: Tom a été assassiné par un tueur à gages.
examples.en: Tom was killed by a hired assassin.

examples.text: J'ai mis ma guitare en gage pour payer le loyer.
examples.en: I pawned my guitar to pay the rent.

examples.text: Nous allons mettre la maison en gage de manière à pouvoir emprunter un peu d'argent.
examples.en: We'll use the house as collateral so we can borrow some money.

examples.text: Tom a dû mettre sa guitare en gage pour payer ses factures.
examples.en: Tom had to pawn his guitar so he could pay his bills.
